status: POST-RESULT EXPLORATORY; neither preregistered nor independent validation
known_results: Original PG negative; P0 positive; long-ES events profitable; directional asymmetry already viewed. All IS years were previously analyzed. OOS remains locked.
hypotheses: Original model may pool unlike directions, omit volatility/correlation/quarter-end state, lack nonlinear terms, or estimate noisy coefficients with too little data. Shrinkage may improve forecast stability.
method: Expanding fit on events completed strictly before decision; >=60 observations; standardization on each training sample; fixed ridge penalty 20 excluding intercept. evaluation: net 1x/2x costs, historical eras, forecast error vs expanding mean, all single-year omissions, removal of largest winner, paired month-block CIs and centered max-t adjustment across all family models; comparisons with original PG and P0
